summary: This bill replaces the underlying text to enact the Foreign Intelligence Accountability Act, which adds civil liberties reviews and criminal penalties for FBI queries of US persons under FISA Section 702, requires warrants to target US persons, and extends Title VII authorities through 2029, plus the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act, which prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing, testing, or using a central bank digital currency directly or indirectly for individuals or monetary policy.
